She helped me to make the right food choices and made me understand the impact of different foods on my body. This has helped me to take healthier decisions day to day. She was always available to address my concerns and adjust the plan as needed. She is always positive and has an encouraging approach, making my journey enjoyable and motivating.​

And yes, the results spoke for themselves. Not only did I experience weight loss, but I also noticed my health getting better, increased energy levels, improved digestion  and confidence. I now approach food with a balanced perspective, no longer viewing it as a source of stress but as a means to nourish and energize my body.​

I am immensely grateful for her expertise and dedication. She didn't just provide a diet plan; she equipped me with the tools and knowledge to lead a healthier life. I wholeheartedly recommend her services to anyone seeking meaningful and lasting improvements in their health and well-being.
Thank you Deepti! You are amazing!​

featured_reviews.review_text: I went to Deepashri after I had exhausted all my options on walking, exercise, gymming and I had not much hope.  But not only did Deepashri help me in my weight loss journey but it was also easy to follow along with my daily job and family obligations.  I could stick to the diet with easy dietary changes and a lifestyle change.  She made me aware of what I can eat and how much to eat.  I have been off the diet for a month now and the weight is still maintained.  It took me about 4 months to reduce 9 kilos but I am sure I couldn't have done it without Deepashri's positive attitude and encouragement.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of working with Deepashri to create a personalized diet plan for managing my hubby's diabetes, and I can't praise her expertise enough.

Deepashri took the time to listen to my concerns, understand my dietary preferences, and tailored a plan that worked perfectly for us

What truly sets her apart is her ability to match the nutrition without compromising on the taste.  We never felt overwhelmed by the dietary changes because she made the process manageable and enjoyable.

Whenever I had questions or needed adjustments to my plan, she was readily available and responsive.

If you're looking for a dietitian who truly cares about your well-being and is exceptionally skilled in their field, I wholeheartedly recommend Deepashri.
